title: Gedidya

paragraphs: Yehudah ben Gedidya, in King Yannai’s time, [Kiddushin 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.66a.10). He told King Yannai, “The crown of kingship is enough for you.”[^1]

notes.text: The linked Kiddushin names Yehudah ben Gedidya and has him urge Yannai to keep the crown of kingship and leave the priesthood to Aaron’s descendants. Hyman quotes only the first part.
